-- The whole point: this reads a table the PIPELINE writes, not n8n's own
-- execution log. A trigger that stops firing produces no execution and no
-- error, so n8n has nothing to report - the log looks perfectly healthy.
-- Absence of a heartbeat is the only evidence that survives that failure.
SELECT name,
       last_success,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - last_success)) / 60 AS silent_minutes
  FROM pipeline_heartbeat
 WHERE name = 'lead_intake';

-- Record that we alerted, so a follow-up workflow can escalate if the
-- silence is still there an hour later instead of repeating the same ping.
INSERT INTO watchdog_alerts (name, silent_minutes, raised_at)
VALUES ('lead_intake', {{ $json.silent_minutes || 0 }}, now());
